about: The Workbench icons of the Airstrike drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is a frame of upstream's data/redplane.png on a sky-blue square. Airstrike-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Airstrike.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Airstrike.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for the licence; Folder.info for data.
